map.第六次复习，长期记忆: Sixth review, moving it into long-term memory

map.眼看、口读、手写、耳听: See it, read it aloud, write it, hear it

map.艾宾浩斯（Hermann Ebbinghaus，1850-1909）是德国著名心: Ebbinghaus (Hermann Ebbinghaus, 1850-1909) was a famous German psychologist. Through experiments on himself he discovered the pattern of forgetting and put forward the well-known theory of the "forgetting curve".
map.研究发现：遗忘在学习之后立即开始，而且遗忘的进程并不是均匀的。最初遗忘速度很快，: His research found that forgetting begins immediately after learning and does not proceed evenly: it is very fast at first, then gradually slows down.
map.0.25-2秒，容量大但保持时间极短: 0.25-2 seconds, large capacity but extremely brief retention
map.几秒到几分钟，容量约7±2个组块: A few seconds to a few minutes, holding about 7±2 chunks
map.几分钟到终身，通过重复复习形成: A few minutes up to a lifetime, formed through repeated review
map.艾宾浩斯复习法的核心就是通过科学间隔的复习，将知识从短时记忆转化为长时记忆。: The core of the Ebbinghaus method is scientifically spaced review that turns knowledge from short-term memory into long-term memory.
map.备考各类考试: Preparing for all kinds of exams
map.📚 深度解析：按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线生成间隔复习日程（如 1/3/7/14 天），提: 📚 In-depth: generates a spaced revision schedule from the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve (for example day 1/3/7/14) to improve retention.
map.日程生成：按输入日期排复习点。: Schedule: lays out revision points from the date you enter.
map.间隔复习：关键节点提醒。: Spaced revision: reminders at the key points.
map.进度跟踪：标记已完成复习。: Progress tracking: mark reviews as completed.
map.示例：今日学新词，安排第 1、3、7、14 天复习。: Example: learn new words today and review them on days 1, 3, 7 and 14.
map.遗忘先快后慢，短时密集复习可巩固。: Forgetting is fast at first and slower later, so intensive review in the early stage helps consolidation.
map.可调整间隔，默认常用 1/3/7/14 天。: They are adjustable; the usual default is 1/3/7/14 days.
map.单词、知识点长期记忆规划。: Planning long-term retention of vocabulary and key points.
